question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa concludes with Caṇḍeśa's characteristics?
premises: The text is identified as the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
This is the chapter on the marks of Caṇḍeśa.
It is numbered as the ninety-second.
inference: The ninety-second chapter on the marks of Caṇḍeśa in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa is concluded.
plain_english: Thus ends the ninety-second chapter, on the marks of Caṇḍeśa, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
